# Install `notion` — Notion — Block Editor

> Nested vertical slice (slice-of-slices) housing the full notion-page-clone block editor.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/notion
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=notion
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/notion

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add notion
# alias: npx rr add notion
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `content`, `notion`, `editor`, `block-editor`, `rich-text`, `slash-menu`, `drag-drop`, `adapter-seam`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add notion`. Wire the `@notion/*` path alias to `./slices/notion/*` in tsconfig. Minimal mount: `<EditorAdapterProvider adapter={{ data }}><PageEditor pageId={id}/></EditorAdapterProvider>` where `data` implements EditorDataAdapter (block+page CRUD over your store — see lib/dataAdapter.ts; a localStorage reference impl lives in the rr preview). Add capabilities incrementally: `selection` for multi-select, `comments` for per-block threads, `database.renderDatabase` to mount your database renderer inside database blocks, `mention.search` for @-typeahead, `page.navigateToPage`/`uploadFile` for nav + media. Convex hosts: copy convex/features/notion (_blocks/_blockOps are pure, unit-tested array ops) and keep handlers thin.

## Tools (agentic surface)

Function-calling tools this slice provides. Register the exported collection on any `@/shared/agentic` host (e.g. `useAgentTools(<x>Tools, ctx)`) and ONE agent can drive this slice alongside others.

**Agent guidance:** Notion workspace pages. search or page.get to find a page id before page.update; page.create makes a new page.

- `notion.page.create`
- `notion.page.get`
- `notion.page.update`
- `notion.search`

rr ships the function list above plus a custom instruction (`registry.systemPrompt()`); bring your own model + key to call them (BYOK).

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
